passA.method: Independent transcription with the openpyxl spreadsheet library (formulas as stored, no macros kept or run)
passA.by: Claude (AI agent), build session: transcription agent A

passB.method: Independent transcription from the workbook's raw package XML (xl/workbook.xml, sharedStrings.xml, and worksheet XML) with the Python standard library only; no spreadsheet library
passB.by: Claude (AI agent), build session: transcription agent B

tables.notes: Formulas are written as stored, without the leading "="; text cells keep their characters, with a line break written as the literal "\n" and a non-breaking space as "\u00a0"; numeric cells are written as Python repr(float(stored value)). Rows were chosen by the build engineer from a reading of the workbook; both passes filled every row and agreed on every cell. The odd ratings in Scale!B4 to B12 are stored as numbers, so they appear as 1.0, 3.0, and so on.
